bio.text: Jeff Peckman is the Unity Party candidate for governor of Colorado in the 2026 general election.
According to his campaign website, he was born in Paola, Kansas, and was the first Vice-President of Special Projects for the DaVinci Institute.
The site says he has run three candidate campaigns and three ballot initiative campaigns over the last 28 years, and published a book, RAISE the ZONE, in March 2026.
